My love,
I’ve been working on something for a long time… so many hours on the laptop (yes, even the ones that annoyed you a little haha). But as we always say Always & Forever , this is my way of keeping that promise alive.

I wanted to create something special for you… something that gives you a message from me every single day. On your bad days, your anxious days, the rainy and heavy days. On the days you’re upset with me, or when I’ve been pesado or made you mad. On the days you’re glowing with happiness and feeling amazing. Every single day of the year you’ll receive a little piece of love from me: your best friend, the love of your heart, your perfect future husband.
Lili, even the simplest moments feel magical when I imagine sharing them with you. You make my heart so full.
